_purpose: T6 at lambda = 1.5, N = 64, to meet gate 4 where t6b did not. The t6b ladder mixed well at N = 36 (26 to 102 round trips) but gave 11 to 15 at N = 64 and 0 to 3 at N = 100. Not a severed ladder: swap acceptance was 0.20 to 0.74 at every link and phi moved smoothly through every rung. It was diffusion across eighteen rungs with a hot end coarse in 1/g and a frozen cold tail (move acceptance 0.001, phi saturated) that added length and nothing else. Here: fourteen rungs, hot end refined, nothing below g = 2.35, and three times the measured rounds. Sampling-efficiency changes only -- the same distributions are sampled. Replica agreement on phi in the transition region was already 0.001 to 0.01 in t6b (ASSUMPTIONS O12); this run exists so that the pre-registered gate is met as written rather than argued around.
name: t6c_lam15_n64
